hook: 당신은 이상한 게 아니다|그 다름이 힘이다

assets.style: Painterly cinematic illustration, mystical and dramatic, deep violet and indigo night with radiant gold light, high contrast, vertical 9:16 composition with one clear subject in the center, no text, no letters, no watermark.

voices.name: l00
voices.text: 어릴 때부터, <#0.2#> 나만 조금 다른 것 같았나요?
voices.caption: 어릴 때부터, 나만 조금 다른 것 같았나요?

voices.name: l03
voices.text: 남들과 달라서 불편했던 그 모습은, <#0.2#> 고장 난 게 아니에요.
voices.caption: 남들과 달라서 불편했던 그 모습은, 고장 난 게 아니에요.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: 당신의 영혼이 이번 생을 위해, <#0.2#> 간직하고 온 재능이에요.
voices.caption: 당신의 영혼이 이번 생을 위해, 간직하고 온 재능이에요.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: 그 다름이, <#0.3#> 당신의 가장 큰 강점이에요.
voices.caption: 그 다름이, 당신의 가장 큰 강점이에요.

images_done: a crowd of identical grey figures walking in the same direction on a city street, one woman among them glowing with a soft colorful light, hunched as if hiding her glow
a glowing soul descending from a starry sky toward the Earth, carrying a small unique crystal of colored light in its hands
the same woman standing still as the grey crowd passes, her colorful light slowly growing brighter around her
the woman standing tall on a hilltop at sunrise, her colorful light shining freely across the valley

animate_done.motion: the grey crowd keeps walking past, the woman's colorful glow flickers, then slowly brightens
